comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-1870 removes a drawer by operating two opposite-sense slide releases and sets it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two coaxial tools for countertorque; PR-1870 simultaneously presses opposed latch levers while pulling and supporting a free drawer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° setting through three cycles; PR-1870 requires the drawer fully off both slides, flat, still and released on the table.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only at a generic level; drawer unlatching and load removal do not test threaded setting preservation, and no rubric details are missing.
